$comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/pdf-theme.json and edit. Every field is optional.
name: Northwind Analytics
$fonts_comment: Five roles. Omit any and the mood decides; omit the block and the mood decides all of it. latin_guest is the Latin face used inside a right-to-left sentence.
$weights_comment: Override any of the mood's weights. emphasis is what <strong> sets: one step above the body, not bold.
$table_comment: Table type relative to the body; 0.86 is the register's default.
$deck_comment: kind: deck geometry. base_scale multiplies the body size on a slide.
$locales_comment: Per-language layer. A document with lang: fa in its frontmatter takes identity fields and, if given, mood / fonts / weights / table from locales.fa.
